import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Only the lightweight summary folder is required to compile the book
SUMMARY_DIR = Path("../data/summary")

df_papers = pd.read_parquet(SUMMARY_DIR / "papers_summary.parquet")
df_versions = pd.read_parquet(SUMMARY_DIR / "versions_summary.parquet")
with open(SUMMARY_DIR / "crawl_meta.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    crawl_meta = json.load(f)

n_assigned = crawl_meta["n_assigned"]
n_crawled = crawl_meta["n_crawled"]
n_failed = crawl_meta["n_failed"]
n_untracked = crawl_meta["n_untracked"]

scope = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Metric": [
            "First ID",
            "Last ID",
            "Assigned IDs",
            "Papers crawled (in papers.jsonl)",
            "Versions crawled",
            "Failed IDs (logged in failures.jsonl)",
            "Never attempted / not logged",
            "Paper-level success rate (%)",
        ],
        "Value": [
            crawl_meta["first_id"],
            crawl_meta["last_id"],
            f"{n_assigned:,}",
            f"{n_crawled:,}",
            f"{crawl_meta['n_versions_crawled']:,}",
            f"{n_failed:,}",
            f"{n_untracked:,}",
            f"{n_crawled / n_assigned * 100:.2f}",
        ],
    }
)
display(scope)

if crawl_meta.get("failed_by_step"):
    print("Failed IDs by crawler step")
    display(
        pd.Series(crawl_meta["failed_by_step"], name="failed_ids")
        .rename_axis("step")
        .to_frame()
    )
    print("Most frequent error messages (IDs normalised)")
    display(
        pd.Series(crawl_meta["failed_by_error"], name="failed_ids")
        .rename_axis("error")
        .to_frame()
    )

INVENTORY_FILE = SUMMARY_DIR / "corpus_inventory.parquet"

if INVENTORY_FILE.exists():
    by_ext = pd.read_parquet(INVENTORY_FILE).set_index("extension")
    n_versions_with_source = int(df_versions["latex_source_path"].notna().sum())
    total_bytes = int(by_ext["total_bytes"].sum())
    non_source_bytes = int(
        by_ext.loc[~by_ext.index.isin([".tex", ".bib"]), "total_bytes"].sum()
    )

    by_ext["share_of_bytes_%"] = (by_ext["total_bytes"] / total_bytes * 100).round(2)

    print(f"Corpus size on disk (after figure removal): {total_bytes / 1e6:,.1f} MB")
    print(f"Average per crawled paper:                  {total_bytes / len(df_papers) / 1e3:,.1f} kB")
    print(f"Average per version with source:            {total_bytes / n_versions_with_source / 1e3:,.1f} kB")
    print(f"Bytes in files other than .tex/.bib:        {non_source_bytes / total_bytes:.1%}")
    display(by_ext.head(10))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
    top = by_ext.head(8)
    sns.barplot(x=top["total_bytes"] / 1e6, y=top.index, ax=ax, color="slategray")
    ax.set_title("Corpus size by file extension (top 8)")
    ax.set_xlabel("Size (MB)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Extension")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("No saved inventory found: skipping the on-disk analysis.")
